name: 科研工作台
description: 启动本地科研工作台，整理研究目标并进入合适的科研工作流程
prompt: 一键更新。请从当前可见对话提取真实科研新进展，匹配已有项目和记录，预检、批量保存并回读；没有新信息时直接说明。

commands.label: 一键更新
commands.description: 直接整理当前对话并同步真实科研进度
commands.prompt: 一键更新。请从当前可见对话提取真实科研新进展，匹配已有项目和记录，预检、批量保存并回读；没有新信息时直接说明。
commands.placeholder: 已有对话包含进展时可直接执行；也可补充项目名称或今天的工作。

commands.label: 一键导入
commands.description: 将当前材料去重后合并到工作台
commands.prompt: 一键导入。请读取我当前提供的科研材料，匹配现有记录，跳过重复事实，预检后合并保存并回读。
commands.placeholder: 粘贴科研记录，或提供 Markdown、CSV、文件路径。

commands.label: 查看科研状态
commands.description: 汇总项目、待办与目前阻塞
commands.prompt: 请读取当前科研状态，汇总论文、实验、待办与阻塞，并给出明确标注的下一步建议。
commands.placeholder: 可补充项目名称；未指定时先查看已有真实项目。

en.name: Research workspace
en.description: Use chat shortcuts to update and import genuine research progress into the local workspace.
en.prompt: Update progress. Extract genuine research updates from the visible conversation, match existing projects and records, validate, apply a batch and read it back. If there is no new information, say so.

commands.label: Update progress
commands.description: Use the visible chat to save genuine research updates.
commands.prompt: Update progress. Extract genuine research updates from the visible conversation, match existing projects and records, validate, apply a batch and read it back. If there is no new information, say so.
commands.placeholder: Use the progress already in this chat, or add a project name and a brief work update.

commands.label: Import progress
commands.description: Deduplicate supplied material and merge it into the workspace.
commands.prompt: Import progress. Read the research material I have provided, match existing records, skip duplicate facts, validate, merge and read back the saved changes.
commands.placeholder: Paste research notes or provide Markdown, CSV or file paths.

commands.label: View research status
commands.description: Summarize projects, pending work and current blockers.
commands.prompt: Read the current research records and summarize papers, experiments, pending work and blockers, with clearly labeled suggestions for the next step.
commands.placeholder: Optionally name a project; otherwise inspect existing real projects first.

name: 进度与任务
description: 在当前 AI 对话中一键更新科研进度，整理聊天或批量材料并自动同步工作台
prompt: 一键更新。请整理当前可见对话中的真实科研进展，匹配已有任务、论文和实验，只写入新变化，预检后批量保存并回读。

commands.label: 一键更新
commands.description: 使用当前聊天中的进展，直接完成同步
commands.prompt: 一键更新。请整理当前可见对话中的真实科研进展，匹配已有任务、论文和实验，只写入新变化，预检后批量保存并回读。
commands.placeholder: 例如：初稿已完成，数据划分说明待补，消融实验尚未运行。

commands.label: 一键导入材料
commands.description: 遇到文件或结构化材料时进入导入工作流
commands.prompt: 一键导入。请按导入工作流处理我当前提供的聊天记录、Markdown、CSV 或文件材料，去重匹配已有项，再预检并保存真实进度。
commands.placeholder: 粘贴材料或提供文件路径；可注明目标项目。

commands.label: 批量更新进度
commands.description: 将多条明确变化作为同一批次更新
commands.prompt: 请批量更新这些科研进度：先读取相关记录和版本，保留旧备注与关联，预检后整体保存明确项并回读，仅询问不能判定的冲突项。
commands.placeholder: 逐条列出任务、论文或实验的变化；可同时提供多个材料。

en.name: Progress and tasks
en.description: Update research progress from the visible chat or supplied material, then verify the saved changes.
en.prompt: Update progress. Organize genuine research updates from the visible conversation, match existing tasks, papers and experiments, and save only new changes after validating the batch. Read back the results.

commands.label: Update progress
commands.description: Save progress already described in the current chat.
commands.prompt: Update progress. Organize genuine research updates from the visible conversation, match existing tasks, papers and experiments, and save only new changes after validating the batch. Read back the results.
commands.placeholder: For example: the first draft is complete, the data-split description needs work, and the ablation has not run.

commands.label: Import research material
commands.description: Route files and structured material through the import workflow.
commands.prompt: Import progress. Use the import workflow for the chat records, Markdown, CSV or files I have supplied. Deduplicate and match existing records, then validate and save genuine research updates.
commands.placeholder: Paste material or provide file paths; specify the project if needed.

commands.label: Update multiple records
commands.description: Apply several clear progress changes in one batch.
commands.prompt: Update these research records in a batch. Read current records and versions, preserve existing notes and links, validate, save the clear changes together and read them back. Ask only about unresolved conflicts.
commands.placeholder: List changes to tasks, papers or experiments, or supply several sources.

name: 一键导入
description: 从聊天、Markdown、CSV 或文件材料提取科研进度，去重并批量合并保存
prompt: 一键导入。请整理我当前提供的科研材料，匹配已有记录并去重合并，预检后保存明确事项，再回读确认。

commands.label: 一键导入
commands.description: 将粘贴文本或当前聊天转为科研记录
commands.prompt: 一键导入。请整理我当前提供的科研材料，匹配已有记录并去重合并，预检后保存明确事项，再回读确认。
commands.placeholder: 粘贴研究笔记、进度表、组会记录或当前对话中的材料。

commands.label: 导入文件材料
commands.description: 读取指定范围内可访问的文件
commands.prompt: 请读取我提供的 Markdown、CSV 或其他可访问文件，提取真实科研信息并保留来源；匹配已有项、去重、预检后批量保存，无法读取的文件单独说明。
commands.placeholder: 提供文件或目录路径，以及需要处理的范围和目标项目。

commands.label: 再次导入与合并
commands.description: 重复材料只合并新增事实，不重复建档
commands.prompt: 请把这些材料与工作台已有记录合并：相同事实跳过，新增事实保留来源，旧值与材料有冲突时只询问不确定项，明确变化预检后保存。
commands.placeholder: 提供更新后的同一材料或补充记录；可注明明确更正的字段。

en.name: Import progress
en.description: Extract research updates from chat, Markdown, CSV or files, deduplicate and merge them into existing records.
en.prompt: Import progress. Organize the research material I have provided, match existing records, deduplicate and merge it, then validate, save clear changes and read them back.

commands.label: Import progress
commands.description: Turn supplied text or the visible chat into research records.
commands.prompt: Import progress. Organize the research material I have provided, match existing records, deduplicate and merge it, then validate, save clear changes and read them back.
commands.placeholder: Paste research notes, a progress table, meeting notes or material from this chat.

commands.label: Import files
commands.description: Read accessible files within the specified scope.
commands.prompt: Read the Markdown, CSV or other accessible files I have supplied. Extract genuine research facts with their sources, match existing records, deduplicate, validate and save a batch. Identify any files you could not read.
commands.placeholder: Provide file or directory paths, the intended scope and the target project.

commands.label: Merge updated material
commands.description: Add new facts without duplicating previously imported records.
commands.prompt: Merge this material with existing workspace records. Skip identical facts, preserve sources for new information, and ask only about unresolved conflicts. Validate and save the clear changes.
commands.placeholder: Provide a revised source or additional notes, identifying any explicit corrections.

name: 科研周报
description: 依据实际进展生成科研周报，区分本期变化、累计状态与下期建议
prompt: 生成周报。请根据当前项目的真实记录生成最近七个日历日的科研周报，区分本期变化与累计状态，保留证据和待确认事项。

commands.label: 生成周报
commands.description: 区分本期新增变化与当前累计状态
commands.prompt: 生成周报。请根据当前项目的真实记录生成最近七个日历日的科研周报，区分本期变化与累计状态，保留证据和待确认事项。
commands.placeholder: 可补充项目名称、报告期及周报保存位置。

commands.label: 准备组会汇报
commands.description: 把实际进展与待讨论问题整理成汇报
commands.prompt: 请基于当前科研记录准备组会汇报，写清实际进展、证据、阻塞和需要导师讨论的问题，建议与事实分别标注。
commands.placeholder: 可补充汇报时长、听众和需要讨论的问题。

en.name: Weekly report
en.description: Build evidence-based reports that distinguish period changes, current status and suggested next steps.
en.prompt: Generate weekly report. Use the current project records to report the last seven calendar days, distinguishing period changes from cumulative status and preserving evidence and open questions.

commands.label: Generate weekly report
commands.description: Separate changes this period from the current cumulative state.
commands.prompt: Generate weekly report. Use the current project records to report the last seven calendar days, distinguishing period changes from cumulative status and preserving evidence and open questions.
commands.placeholder: Optionally specify the project, reporting period and output location.

commands.label: Prepare a group update
commands.description: Present actual progress and questions for discussion.
commands.prompt: Prepare a group-meeting update from the current research records. Include actual progress, evidence, blockers and questions for the advisor, keeping facts and suggestions separate.
commands.placeholder: Optionally specify the presentation length, audience and questions to discuss.

name: 论文写作
description: 基于已有研究材料起草和修订论文，同步章节状态并标明证据缺口
prompt: 请阅读当前论文和已有研究证据，起草我指定的章节；没有依据的结果或引用明确待补，并保存稿件与实际写作状态。

commands.label: 起草论文
commands.description: 依照实际研究证据推进指定章节
commands.prompt: 请阅读当前论文和已有研究证据，起草我指定的章节；没有依据的结果或引用明确待补，并保存稿件与实际写作状态。
commands.placeholder: 指定论文、章节、目标语言和现有稿件路径。

commands.label: 修订论文
commands.description: 保留科学主张与来源，落实明确修改
commands.prompt: 请根据我提供的意见修订当前论文，保留可追踪事实，解释涉及科学主张的变化，保存稿件并同步实际章节状态。
commands.placeholder: 提供稿件路径、修改意见或审稿反馈。

commands.label: 更新论文进度
commands.description: 依据用户确认同步阶段和人工百分比
commands.prompt: 更新论文进度。请使用当前可见对话中已确认的写作变化，匹配论文记录，保留章节和关联，预检后保存并回读；不自行估计百分比。
commands.placeholder: 例如：方法部分完成，初稿进入修改阶段，自估进度 60%。

en.name: Paper writing
en.description: Draft and revise papers using actual research material, update sections and identify evidence gaps.
en.prompt: Read the current paper and available research evidence, then draft the section I specify. Mark unsupported results or citations as missing, save the manuscript and record its actual writing status.

commands.label: Draft a paper section
commands.description: Use actual research evidence to develop the requested section.
commands.prompt: Read the current paper and available research evidence, then draft the section I specify. Mark unsupported results or citations as missing, save the manuscript and record its actual writing status.
commands.placeholder: Specify the paper, section, target language and existing manuscript path.

commands.label: Revise a paper
commands.description: Implement requested changes while preserving claims and sources.
commands.prompt: Revise the current paper using the feedback I provide. Preserve traceable facts, explain changes to scientific claims, save the manuscript and synchronize its actual section status.
commands.placeholder: Provide the manuscript path and revision requests or reviewer feedback.

commands.label: Update paper progress
commands.description: Save confirmed stages and the user’s own progress estimate.
commands.prompt: Update paper progress. Use confirmed writing updates from the visible conversation to match the paper, preserve its sections and associations, validate, save and read it back. Do not invent a percentage.
commands.placeholder: For example: the methods section is complete, revision has started, and I estimate overall progress at 60%.

name: 实验设计与结果
description: 设计可检验的实验并登记实际结果，保留运行条件、基线和证据
prompt: 请依据当前研究问题整理可检验的实验方案，说明假设、基线、指标、条件和失败判定，将方案登记为计划而非已执行结果。

commands.label: 设计实验
commands.description: 将研究问题转为可验证方案
commands.prompt: 请依据当前研究问题整理可检验的实验方案，说明假设、基线、指标、条件和失败判定，将方案登记为计划而非已执行结果。
commands.placeholder: 补充研究问题、已有方法、数据和资源约束。

commands.label: 登记实验结果
commands.description: 从真实结果材料中保存指标与证据
commands.prompt: 请读取我提供的实验结果和日志，核对指标、基线、运行条件和来源，登记实际结果；没有结果证据时不要标记完成。
commands.placeholder: 提供结果表、运行日志或明确的实验结果说明。

commands.label: 更新实验进度
commands.description: 区分计划、运行、受阻与实际完成
commands.prompt: 更新实验进度。请根据当前对话和已有记录同步实验状态，明确实际运行到哪一步，保留来源；预检后保存并回读。
commands.placeholder: 例如：协议已写好但尚未运行；或因数据缺失而受阻。

en.name: Experiments and results
en.description: Design testable experiments and record actual results with conditions, baselines and evidence.
en.prompt: Use the current research question to develop a testable experimental plan with a hypothesis, baseline, metrics, conditions and failure criteria. Record it as planned work, not an executed result.

commands.label: Design an experiment
commands.description: Turn a research question into a testable plan.
commands.prompt: Use the current research question to develop a testable experimental plan with a hypothesis, baseline, metrics, conditions and failure criteria. Record it as planned work, not an executed result.
commands.placeholder: Add the research question, existing method, available data and resource constraints.

commands.label: Record experiment results
commands.description: Save metrics and evidence from actual result material.
commands.prompt: Read the results and logs I provide, check metrics, baselines, run conditions and sources, and record the actual outcomes. Do not mark an experiment complete without results and evidence.
commands.placeholder: Provide result tables, run logs or an explicit account of the experimental outcome.

commands.label: Update experiment progress
commands.description: Distinguish planned, running, blocked and completed work.
commands.prompt: Update experiment progress. Use the current conversation and existing records to save the actual experimental status, explain what has run and preserve sources. Validate, save and read back.
commands.placeholder: For example: the protocol is written but the run has not started, or missing data is blocking the run.

name: 导师指导
description: 整理真实导师反馈与行动，或提供明确标注为 AI 的科研指导建议
prompt: 请整理我提供的真实导师反馈并保存，保留原意和来源；把已确认的行动建立为关联任务，不补造导师身份、日期或意见。

commands.label: 记录导师反馈
commands.description: 保留真实意见并关联落实任务
commands.prompt: 请整理我提供的真实导师反馈并保存，保留原意和来源；把已确认的行动建立为关联任务，不补造导师身份、日期或意见。
commands.placeholder: 粘贴导师意见、会议纪要或提供记录文件。

commands.label: 获取 AI 指导
commands.description: 独立保存明确标注的研究建议
commands.prompt: 请审视当前研究状态，给出有依据且可落实的 AI 研究建议，独立保存到建议记录，不归因为真实导师意见。
commands.placeholder: 补充想解决的研究问题或当前最困难的决定。

commands.label: 跟进导师任务
commands.description: 检查真实反馈对应行动的实际进展
commands.prompt: 请读取现有导师反馈与关联任务，根据当前对话核对落实进展，更新明确变化，列出尚待处理的事项。
commands.placeholder: 可提供反馈记录名称和已完成工作的说明。

en.name: Advisor guidance
en.description: Record genuine advisor feedback and follow-up actions, or save clearly labeled AI research advice.
en.prompt: Summarize advisor feedback. Organize and save the genuine feedback I provide, preserving its meaning and source. Create linked tasks for confirmed actions without inventing identities, dates or opinions.

commands.label: Summarize advisor feedback
commands.description: Preserve genuine feedback and link confirmed follow-up tasks.
commands.prompt: Summarize advisor feedback. Organize and save the genuine feedback I provide, preserving its meaning and source. Create linked tasks for confirmed actions without inventing identities, dates or opinions.
commands.placeholder: Paste advisor comments or meeting notes, or provide a source file.

commands.label: Get AI research advice
commands.description: Save research suggestions clearly identified as AI advice.
commands.prompt: Assess the current research state and provide reasoned, actionable AI research advice. Save it separately as AI suggestions, without attributing it to my actual advisor.
commands.placeholder: Describe the research question or decision you most need help with.

commands.label: Track advisor actions
commands.description: Check actual progress against feedback and linked tasks.
commands.prompt: Read existing advisor feedback and linked tasks, use the current conversation to check follow-up progress, save clear changes and list remaining actions.
commands.placeholder: Optionally name the feedback record and describe work already completed.

name: 文献与证据
description: 核验文献来源并整理实际阅读记录，连接论文与可追溯的研究证据
prompt: 请核验我提供的文献标题、作者、年份、DOI 或链接，去重后加入阅读台账，并准确说明核验与阅读范围。

commands.label: 登记文献
commands.description: 核验来源后加入阅读台账
commands.prompt: 请核验我提供的文献标题、作者、年份、DOI 或链接，去重后加入阅读台账，并准确说明核验与阅读范围。
commands.placeholder: 提供 DOI、论文链接、标题或本地 PDF 路径。

commands.label: 整理阅读笔记
commands.description: 提炼实际阅读材料支持的结论和局限
commands.prompt: 请读取我提供的文献材料与笔记，整理主要方法、结论、局限和与课题的关系，保存实际阅读范围及来源。
commands.placeholder: 提供可读取的文献、笔记和当前研究问题。

commands.label: 关联论文证据
commands.description: 把已核验文献连接到目标论文
commands.prompt: 请从已有文献中选择与目标论文相关的真实证据，解释关联理由并保存关联，保留原有文献列表，不虚构引用内容。
commands.placeholder: 指定目标论文及相关文献名称或 ID。

en.name: Literature and evidence
en.description: Verify sources, organize actual reading notes and connect papers to traceable research evidence.
en.prompt: Verify the titles, authors, years, DOIs or links I provide, deduplicate them and add the papers to the reading record. State the actual verification and reading scope.

commands.label: Add literature
commands.description: Verify sources and add them to the reading record.
commands.prompt: Verify the titles, authors, years, DOIs or links I provide, deduplicate them and add the papers to the reading record. State the actual verification and reading scope.
commands.placeholder: Provide DOIs, paper links, titles or local PDF paths.

commands.label: Organize reading notes
commands.description: Extract findings and limitations supported by the material read.
commands.prompt: Read the literature and notes I provide. Summarize methods, findings, limitations and relevance to the project, then save the actual reading scope and sources.
commands.placeholder: Provide accessible papers, notes and the current research question.

commands.label: Link paper evidence
commands.description: Connect verified literature to the target paper.
commands.prompt: Select relevant evidence from existing literature records for the target paper, explain and save the associations, preserve existing links and avoid inventing citation content.
commands.placeholder: Specify the target paper and relevant literature titles or IDs.

name: 论文审查
description: 结合真实稿件和证据进行模拟审查，提出可核查的问题与修订顺序
prompt: 请审查当前实际稿件的论证、方法、基线、证据和可复现性，给出具体位置与可行改进，并独立保存为 AI 审查建议。

commands.label: 审查论文
commands.description: 检查论证、方法、证据与可复现性
commands.prompt: 请审查当前实际稿件的论证、方法、基线、证据和可复现性，给出具体位置与可行改进，并独立保存为 AI 审查建议。
commands.placeholder: 提供稿件路径、论文名称或重点关注的章节。

commands.label: 整理修订顺序
commands.description: 把已审查问题转为有依据的优先事项
commands.prompt: 请依据现有稿件和审查意见整理修订优先级，区分材料已显示的问题、缺失信息和待实验验证事项，保存明确标注的 AI 建议。
commands.placeholder: 提供审查意见或希望优先解决的问题。

en.name: Critical paper review
en.description: Review real manuscripts and evidence, then prioritize specific issues and feasible revisions.
en.prompt: Review the actual manuscript’s argument, methods, baselines, evidence and reproducibility. Provide specific locations and feasible improvements, and save them separately as AI review suggestions.

commands.label: Review a paper
commands.description: Examine arguments, methods, evidence and reproducibility.
commands.prompt: Review the actual manuscript’s argument, methods, baselines, evidence and reproducibility. Provide specific locations and feasible improvements, and save them separately as AI review suggestions.
commands.placeholder: Provide a manuscript path, paper name or sections to focus on.

commands.label: Prioritize revisions
commands.description: Turn supported review findings into ordered next steps.
commands.prompt: Use the manuscript and review feedback to prioritize revisions, separating demonstrated problems, missing information and issues requiring experiments. Save the output as clearly labeled AI suggestions.
commands.placeholder: Provide review feedback or the issues you want to address first.

name: 选题与研究假设
description: 结合真实资源与已有证据筛选研究问题，形成可证伪假设和最小验证路径，适用于选题、缩小方向和比较研究方案。
prompt: 请使用 $phd-ideation，结合我现有资料和资源，提出可验证的研究方向，比较风险，并推荐最小验证路径。

commands.label: 帮我选题
commands.description: 依据真实资源提出并比较可验证方向
commands.prompt: 请使用 $phd-ideation，结合我现有资料和资源，提出可验证的研究方向，比较风险，并推荐最小验证路径。
